description: Backend server for Bang Story web (ported from the Electron main process)
name: bang-story-web-backend

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc ../shared/*.ts --outDir dist/shared --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck && cp ../shared/higgsfield-catalog.json dist/shared/ && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json
